answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farms. Claiming one of 200 slots burns 50 POA, a jade mark — sunk, never returned. That ridge buys a slot for 20 epochs: verified work earns up to 200 POA, an idle slot only 5 POA. A farm burning 100 slots pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA and collects 100 x 5 = 500 POA, losing 4,500 POA. One honest agent pays 50 once and nets 150 POA. The rules fit in a sonnet: fourteen lines, fixed terms, no second identity.
